card.name: Scattered words in drug-label sentences
card.fires_on: No single word or setting is shared. It fires on scattered words such as 'to', 'dosage', 'into' and 'a' inside drug-label sentences, and on a few web passages about Japan.

modes.label: Dose words in interaction text
modes.description: The word dosage or dose right after a drug name or 'equivalent' in interaction or conversion statements.
modes.example: Do not use lopinavir and ritonavir with avanafil because a safe and effective avanafil<< dosage>> regimen has not been established.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Short words like to, into, a and for in the middle of a clause.
modes.example: if we take<< into>> cognizance the ODA Japan offers
